name: Cyclist Squat
instructions: Put your heels on a slant board, a wedge or a pair of weight plates, with your feet close together and your toes pointing forward.
Hold a dumbbell vertically against your chest by one end.
Keep your torso upright and bend your knees. Let them travel forward over your toes as you lower your hips straight down.
Go as deep as you can while you keep your heels on the elevation and your torso upright.
Push through your whole foot to stand up again.
